The scene features hexagonal honeycomb tunnels rendered in dark, earthy tones, partially filled with sandy debris that ants are actively moving. A swarm of small ants scurry through the passages, some visibly carrying larger clumps of sand and debris. The visualization captures the constant, busy motion of a living colony through subtle animations: ants move with random directional changes, bounce off tunnel walls, and occasionally carry objects.
